sources.entry: qBittorrent - Free cross-platform bittorrent client with a feature rich Web UI for remote access. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 C++

summary.one_liner: qBittorrent is a free, cross-platform BitTorrent client written in C++/Qt that uses libtorrent-rasterbar.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes qBittorrent as a BitTorrent client programmed in C++ with Qt, built on the libtorrent (libtorrent-rasterbar) library. It states it aims to be a fast, stable alternative to other BitTorrent clients with Unicode support and many features. It resolves peer countries using the DB-IP IP to Country Lite database, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Source tarballs and binaries are PGP-signed starting from v3.3.4. The README points to an INSTALL file for installation, a wiki, a forum for troubleshooting, a bug tracker, and an IRC channel. The README does not list specific features in detail; the awesome-list entry adds that it has a feature-rich Web UI for remote access.
use_cases: remote control of a torrent client via web browser
how_to_run: Refer to the INSTALL file in the repository for installation instructions.
notable: Built on libtorrent-rasterbar by Arvid Norberg
Web UI for remote access (per awesome-selfhosted listing)
Resolves peer countries with DB-IP IP to Country Lite database
Source tarballs and binaries PGP-signed from v3.3.4 onward
caveats: The README itself gives no detailed feature list or platform specifics; installation is delegated to the INSTALL file
Peer-country lookup depends on a third-party database licensed under CC BY 4.0
